requirements.description: Click Join Healing Sky in the main navigation and select Join as a Client to open the client registration page.

On the client registration page: 1. Full Name: type literal text 'Alex Morgan'. 2. Email: type literal text 'alex_random_test_99@yopmail.com' without using credential_key. 3. Phone Country Code: click the country code dropdown selector and select '+1' or 'United States (+1)'. 4. Phone Number: type literal text '2025550143'. 5. Date of Birth: select Month 'June', Date '4', Year '1999'. 6. Address Lookup: type '1 Wall St, New York, NY' and click the address suggestion. 7. Referral Code: type 'NAN5EM09'. 8. Click Submit to register.

From the Healing Sky homepage, navigate to the client sign-in page, select Email as the OTP delivery method, enter the configured client email mithu@yopmail.com using credential_key clientEmail, and click Log in to open the OTP verification screen.

On the client OTP verification screen, enter the configured OTP bypass value 1234 using credential_key clientOtp into the OTP fields, click Verify, and confirm that the authenticated client dashboard (/client/dashboard) is displayed.
From the authenticated client dashboard, click the user profile avatar or account dropdown menu to reveal the account options, then click Log Out or Logout to complete log out.
